svg.title: When were failure flags found?
svg.desc: Formal RQ1 compact JSONL. Curves pool flagged cases across five runs and divide counts by five; x-axis is fraction of each run actual fuzzing duration.
svg.text: Mean cumulative flags across five runs · elapsed fuzzing time as a fraction of each run
OF flags appear mostly after mid-run; the cumulative counts keep growing near the time limit.
End-of-run mean CF: 59.2 / 7.0 / 0.2 / 2.8; mean OF: 4.0 / 0 / 6.0 / 6.6 (solver order in legend).
Each curve is a five-run mean. LaCAM* ran 6 h/run; the other solvers ran 1 h/run. X-axes normalize actual run durations.
Five initial-pool PIBT CF flags are placed at 0%; see the five-run count heatmap for run-to-run variation.
